rubric.evidence:
Status is

; output regions aria-live; inputs start disabled and enable onReady; worker errors post {type:error} and surface on the page ('Embedding failed: …', 'Search failed: …', 'Clustering failed: …'). Download/progress/retry from the shared loader.

Every visible control is a real labelled native element driving the real model: textareas (overview query, basics A/B), search input (practical), example chips (4 overview, 4 basics, 4 practical), shuffle+run button (wild). All keyboard-operable; empty-input paths clear output honestly. Full drive-through of every control at both viewports is the pending validator's job.

No hardcoded similarities anywhere: every bar, score, matrix cell, gauge number and nearest-neighbour link derives from the live engine.embed() result. Example chip sentences are inputs, not outputs; document/FAQ lists are inputs. Baseline probe values (0.9357) recorded as evidence only, never rendered.

Labelled textareas/inputs; role=status/aria-live on status + result regions; similarity bars carry role=img + aria-label with the numeric value; cosine matrix is a real <table> with caption + scope row/col headers + title tooltips; chips are <button type=button>. Guidance consulted: accessibility, forms, accessible-error-announcement.
rubric.notes: Full keyboard drive-through pending validator run.

rubric.evidence: Layout uses the shared design system + fluid grids (auto-fit minmax), overflow-x:auto wrapper on the wide matrix, box-sizing on inputs; no fixed pixel widths. rubric.evidence: Inference + prefixing + pooling run in a dedicated module Worker; main thread only renders. Inputs debounced (450–500ms). Batched embed calls (one worker round-trip per run: 6 texts overview, 11 practical, 12 wild) keep postMessage overhead low.
